name: caliu
description: Search, read, write and organize your Caliu notes.

interface.longDescription:
Caliu is a calm, local-first Markdown notes app for the web, iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Android. Connect it to ChatGPT and your notes come with you into the chat.

Ask ChatGPT to find what you wrote about a project, save a conversation as a note, summarize this week's meeting notes, or add an item to a checklist. ChatGPT can search, read, create, edit, archive, and trash notes, attach images and files, and see your tags. Tags come from #hashtags and links from [[Note Title]], so everything ChatGPT writes lands in the right place in your sidebar.

You approve the connection on Caliu's own page, and you can revoke it anytime under Connected apps. Caliu only reaches the notes in the account you connect.
defaultPrompt: Find my notes about the Lisbon trip.
Save this conversation as a note tagged #ideas.
Add 'buy sunscreen' to my travel checklist.

positive.description: Find notes by topic and read one
positive.prompt: Find my notes about the Lisbon trip and tell me the plan for Saturday.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the note "Lisbon trip — November" and answers from its itinerary table: Belém, Pastéis de Belém and LX Factory.

positive.description: Save a conversation as a tagged note
positive.prompt: Save this conversation as a note tagged #ideas.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a new note with a title, a summary of the conversation and the #ideas tag, and replies with the note's title.

positive.description: Add an item to a checklist
positive.prompt: Add 'buy sunscreen' to my travel checklist.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the pinned note "Travel checklist" and adds an open task "buy sunscreen" to its list, keeping the existing tasks as they were.
Finds the two notes tagged #old ("Apartment hunting 2024" and "Conference notes — 2023") and archives both, without touching other notes.

positive.prompt: Which tags do I use most?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's tags with their note counts, nested tags shown with their parent (for example travel/lisbon, work/projects/atlas).

negative.description: A question unrelated to the user's notes. Caliu should not be called; ChatGPT answers on its own or says it has no weather data.
A writing request with no request to save it. Caliu should not be called; ChatGPT writes the poem in the chat.
A web search. Caliu only reaches the user's own notes, so it should not be called; ChatGPT uses web search or answers on its own.
negative.prompt: Search the web for the best notes apps.

review.commerce_description: Caliu does not sell anything or take payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: search, read, create, edit, archive and trash notes, attach images and files, and see tags.
